title: Namaz for the removal of difficulties.
data:
Shaykh al-Kulayni, in his book Ta'bir al-Ru'ya, has reported on the authority of al-Washsha' that Imam al-Rida (a) said: In my sleep, I saw my father saying to me: Son, whenever you are in trouble, repeat this saying as many times as possible:
يَا رَؤُوْفُ يَا رَحِيْمُ۔
YAA RA-OOFU YAA RAHEEM.
O Most Compassionate, O Most Merciful.
Imam al-Rida (a) then commented, "There is no difference between what we (the Holy Infallibles) see in waking and what we see in sleep."
